question: How does Purana-grace devotion lead mind-gone ones to supreme accomplishment?
premises: in Purana too, of that very, from grace devotion is accepted
by which they go to supreme accomplishment
inference: Puranic grace-devotion carries state-absorbed minds to the supreme.
uncertainties: purana reading kept per gloss; independent verification pending
plain_english: In Purana too, of that very, from grace devotion is accepted — by which they go to supreme accomplishment, mind-gone to his state.
